integrity: Self-contained algebraic proof; executable finite consistency checks; no independent audit has been conducted.
scientific_limitations: Linear radius-one perfect codes of flag-rank minimum distance three only; fixed coordinate labels, not isometry classes. Exhaustive checks use selected small prime fields; arbitrary prime powers follow from proof. Earlier rank-three projective constructions and the necessary length equation are prior results.
title: All one-perfect linear flag-rank codes: existence, classification, and exact enumeration
